gaps.lead: Nobody can say that he doesn't work hard.
People believe she was the finest pianist of her generation.
gaps.sentence: She ___ the finest pianist of her generation.
gaps.explanation: A present belief about a past event: is thought to have + participle.

gaps.lead: My grandfather had completely forgotten that he phoned me last night.
gaps.sentence: My grandfather didn't ___ phoning me last night.
gaps.explanation: 'Completely forgotten' becomes 'didn't have any recollection of'.

gaps.lead: The tickets cost so much that we stayed at home.
gaps.sentence: They were ___ we stayed at home.
gaps.explanation: so much (money) → such expensive tickets (no article with plurals).

gaps.lead: He finally succeeded in solving the puzzle.
gaps.explanation: manage to do = be able to do.

gaps.lead: Assembling the wardrobe took me two hours.
gaps.explanation: it took me X to do = I spent X doing.
